designationHistory.indexText: Fern Cave National Wildlife Refuge, established in 1981, consists of 199 acres of forested hillside underlain by a massive cave with many stalactite and stalagmite-filled rooms.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
